text:
julia_sales: Heads up 9:30 PT tomorrow AcmeNorth wants a short demo under production-like load. They requested a temporary hosted quota increase to 90 QPS for 90 minutes. They're ok with scoped key + IP allowlist. Deal: ACME-N-501. Can infra support and finance ok with a credit?

omar_se: 90 QPS sustained for 90m, mostly text completions ~80 tok/resp, concurrency ~15. Any embeddings in the flow?

julia_sales: No embeddings. Just chat + a few classification calls.

tess_infra: Hosted should handle 90 QPS. We'll create an ephemeral scoped key with rate_limit override and an IP allowlist. Need CIDR, start/end times, and approval for a fallback route if capacity spikes. Also request TTL 30 mins post-demo for key rotation.

kai_sre: Fallback to smaller model variant is strongly recommended (redwood-mini). We can attach routing policy to the key. Also add an alert: >5% 5xx for demo window to page oncall.

billing-bot: Provisional credit: $750 applied to ACME-N-501. Chargeback if usage exceeds estimate.

julia_sales: CIDR is 52.12.44.128/25. Start 2026-03-23T04:30:00Z end 2026-03-23T06:00:00Z (09:3011:00 PT).

tess_infra: Sample admin payload we'll use to issue key:
```
POST /admin/keys
{
  "owner": "sales:ACME-N-501",
  "scopes": ["completion:invoke","classification:invoke"],
  "rate_limit": {"requests_per_second": 90, "burst": 180},
  "ip_allowlist": ["52.12.44.128/25"],
  "expires_at": "2026-03-23T06:30:00Z",
  "metadata": {"purpose": "POC-demo-AcmeNorth"}
}
```
We'll tag as `poc/acme-n-501/ephemeral` and enable audit logs.

harry_cust_success: I'll coordinate test traffic 20 minutes prior and collect logs.

omar_se: Endpoint for them: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate header Authorization: Bearer <POC-ACME-N-501>. We will rotate token after expiry.

tess_infra: Provisioned. Key in vault, rate-limited to 90 RPS and burst 180. Routing policy includes fallback to redwood-mini and canary set to 100% with fallback. Audit ID: audit-POC-7012.

kai_sre: Smoke test results: median latency 95ms, p95 310ms, error rate 0.8% at 20 concurrent. All good.

julia_sales: Customer gave thumbs up after demo. Marking as done. :white_check_mark:
